narrative.overview: A calm, compact owner-only operational surface for private Telegram reply assistance. It makes the next safe action obvious before implementation detail.
keyCharacteristics: Dense but breathable mobile-first operational information.
Flat tonal layers, not ornamental depth.

rules.name: The One-Action Rule
rules.body: Clear Action Blue is reserved for the single next useful action and the current selection.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards stay flat at rest; tonal contrast explains structure.

dos: Do use Telegram theme variables first.
Do pair every status color with a concise Russian text label.
donts: Don't build a noisy monitoring wall or a generic SaaS metric dashboard.
Don't use decorative AI effects, gradient text, glassmorphism, or colored side-stripe cards.
